sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri Prashant Sharma - Advocate for the applicant.
Smt.Anjali Gyanani - Public Prosecutor for the respondent/S  ORDER
The applicant has filed this first application under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of bail.

The applicant has been arrested on 18.12.2023 by Police Station Dabra, District Gwalior relating to Crime No.630/2022 for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 read with Section 34 of IPC.
2.
It is the submission of counsel for the applicant that he is suffering confinement since 18.12.2023 and suffered almost ten months' incarceration, whereas charge sheet has already been filed.
Matter pertains to documentary evidence.
Looking to the nature of allegation, applicant can not temper with the evidence.

It is further submitted that the applicant was taken by Sohanlal to complete certain formalities at Court and therefore he was swayed by the persuasion of Sohanlal and he did not know the implication.
This fact is strengthened by the fact that the applicant does not bear any criminal record and this was his first tryst with legal proceedings, therefore, he was unaware.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-GWL:15805 2 MCRC-38861-2024 He never had any intention to involve in such activities.
He undertakes to abide by all the terms and conditions as imposed by this Court and would not try to temper with the evidence.
Looking to the period of custody and nature of offence, his case may be considered for bail.

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer and prayed for dismissal of the application.
4. Heard learned counsel for the parties at length and perused the case diary.

5. Considering the submissions advanced by the learned counsel for the parties and looking to the period of custody and nature of offence, but without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court intends to allow this application.
Accordingly, the application is allowed.
Certified Copy as per rules.
